title: Fan-minimum balance law: ln R_min = 4/(A+B) and the CF reduction of the walk-finance frontier
statement: Along a dangerous fan L_k = q + kQ (dangerous convergent q of theta_rot = log(3/2)/log 3, positive convergent step Q, partial quotient a members), the break-even schedule's required improvement R_k = (theta_k/theta_{k+1})(L_{k+1}/L_k) satisfies ln R_k = 1/(A-k) + 1/(B+k) + O(second order) with A = eps/eta (within 1 of the dangerous-position partial quotient) and B = q/Q in (0,1); it is minimized at the balance point k* = (A-B)/2 with ln R_min = 4/(A+B) + O((A+B)^{-2}). Hence exp(4/(a+2)) <= R_min <~ exp(4/a) for the fan closed by quotient a, and the schedule's required-improvement infimum over all fans is 1 iff the partial quotients of log 2/log 3 at the dangerous positions are unbounded — a classical OPEN problem. The walk-finance competition program terminates at this reduction.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / continued fraction of log 2 / log 3
tested_range: both certified fans of the competition artifact: fan A (q = 176251, Q = 301994, a14 = 55): A = 55.811, B = 0.5836, k* = 27.61, predicted R_min 1.0735 vs measured 1.07353 (error 4e-4), minimizer 8632083 predicted and observed; fan B (q = 16785921, Q = 17087915, a16 = 4): predicted 2.137 vs measured 2.163 (inside the second-order band), minimizer 50961751 predicted and observed; future-fan table from the observed (uncertified) quotients [3,1,1,15,1,9,2,5]
notes: The first-order derivation is a one-page human computation (the DK envelope factor cancels at a common floor; eps_k = eps - k eta is exact after eps = -ln(1-theta)/ln 3). The competition's measured mystery constant 1.0735 is exp(4/(A+B)) with A+B = 56.39 — nothing but the certified quotient 55. Boundedness of the CF quotients of log 2/log 3 is OPEN; Gauss-Kuzmin genericity expects unbounded (23 and 55 already occur). Not a Baker revival (effective gap routes stay REFUTED). Arithmetic only; no floor verification; no new period bound. Not a halt theorem.
